_comment: M7-18 claim-channel A/B (NOT the CI-gated arena): what reading the opponent cop's capture claims is worth to an evader, under the counted physics. The three thief arms are the SAME brain with the SAME options - only the information feed differs, so the columns isolate the channel. evader-fix = hidden (the pre-M7-18 thief); evader-lag1 = truth-lag1 (the arm the M7-14 instrument used to model claim-reading); evader-claim = truth (lag 0 - what the peer path ACTUALLY delivers, measured 159/161 exact at decision time under this model). The police arms span the adaptation axis: ref-police has never met a claim-reader, police-brain-bookv1 is our deployed generalist (pool included the claim-reader), police-brain-lag1spec was tuned against it directly. champion_pin null: this measures an information channel, it does not gate our champion.
